name: daytona
notes: Their core went private in June 2026, so there is no self-hosted counterpart subject to measure alongside this one.
Published sub-90 ms p99 cold start is a blog figure with no stated methodology, hardware, region or run count. It belongs in the manifest as a citation, never as our number.
Driven through the public REST API at app.daytona.io. Hosted, so the network round trip to their region is inside every number; the class and limit source say so.

create.definition: sandbox create call until it will accept an exec, from a client in the same region

round_trip.definition: exec submitted until the command has completed
